Hiroko Kuwata ( Japanese : 桑田寛子 ; born 18 December 1990) is a Japanese tennis player. Kuwata has won one WTA 125 doubles title, as well as seven singles and 24 doubles titles on the ITF Women's Circuit . On 9 May 2016, she reached her best singles ranking of world No. 150. On 13 July 2015, she peaked at No. 112 in the WTA doubles rankings. Career [ edit ] Kuwata made her WTA Tour debut at the 2014 Washington Open , having entered the qualifying tournament and defeating Sanaz Marand and Stéphanie Dubois for a spot in the main draw. She was thereby pitted against world No. 45, Alison Riske , and defeated the American in straight sets, losing five games in the process. It was Kuwata's first main-draw win at the WTA Tour-level. [ 2 ] She also competed in the doubles event, partnering with Kurumi Nara to defeat Nicola Slater and Emily Webley-Smith in the first round. The Japanese advanced to the final of the event, losing to Shuko Aoyama and Gabriela Dabrowski . [ 3 ] Partnering with Jessica Failla , Kuwata won the doubles title at the WTA 125 2024 Barranquilla Open , defeating Quinn Gleason and Ingrid Martins in the final.
